g.text: Current entering the positive terminal defines absorbed power

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: The right current reference exits the positive terminal; it does not make an ordinary resistor into a source. Signed delivery power is negative for a
passive resistor. The same physical current has i_d=−i; voltage polarity stays fixed.
